generic_runtime_findings.name: Dynamic value provider precedence
generic_runtime_findings.reusable_abstraction: ResolveDynamic(id, scope, ordered_provider_chain) with source trace

generic_runtime_findings.name: Tagged FixPoint representation/scales
generic_runtime_findings.reusable_abstraction: RawFixPoint(value, mode); preserve integer raw bytes alongside interpretation
generic_runtime_findings.proven_native_core: Low mode bit selects decoding: mode0 (raw & ~1)/2^33; mode1 (raw & ~1)/2^26. Raw ONE in mode0 is 8589934592.
remaining_uncertainty: Exact native conversion for all edge values

generic_runtime_findings.name: FixPoint selected arithmetic
generic_runtime_findings.reusable_abstraction: Versioned raw arithmetic policy with supported domain and explicit gap outside it
generic_runtime_findings.proven_native_core: Bounded nonoverflow mode0 multiplication: (((a>>1)*(b>>1))>>32)<<1. Positive safe-domain mode0 division has independently checked even-quantum rounding.

generic_runtime_findings.name: HealData construction and pre-events
generic_runtime_findings.reusable_abstraction: HealRequest -> mutable HealData -> ordered pre-event stage
generic_runtime_findings.proven_native_core: Setup binds healer MaxHP to d50 and target MaxHP to d70, selected properties and callback data; pre-events can modify HealData.

generic_runtime_findings.name: Heal FormulaType2 native core
generic_runtime_findings.reusable_abstraction: HealFormula(policy=type2, typed_raw_operands, cap_policy) -> amount/resource-related output
generic_runtime_findings.proven_native_core: b=FixAdd(FixMul(d50,d28),d60); o=FixMul(b,FixAdd(FixAdd(ONE,dD0),d38)); c=FixAdd(FixMul(FixAdd(ONE,d128),FixDiv(d48,HUNDRED)),FixDiv(dD8,HUNDRED)); amount=max(0,FixMul(o,c)); flag154 conditionally caps to max(0,FixMul(d70,d68)-d40). d50 is healer MaxHP.

generic_runtime_findings.name: ModifyHealData callback mutation
generic_runtime_findings.reusable_abstraction: MutateHealData(field, evaluated_delta, bounds)
generic_runtime_findings.proven_native_core: Selected callback adds received-healing correction to HealData+0x38, with property/range processing.

generic_runtime_findings.name: HealHP settlement chain
generic_runtime_findings.reusable_abstraction: HealSettlement transaction with ordered writes/events; no unconditional HP+amount shortcut
generic_runtime_findings.proven_native_core: HealHP -> SetupHealData -> pre helpers -> HealFormula -> settlement -> DirectChangeHP -> ModifyProperty -> wrapper/storage/persistent write. Post-heal events/resources also occur.

generic_runtime_findings.name: DirectChangeHP / ModifyProperty / persistent storage

generic_runtime_findings.name: SetDynamicValue scoped store

natasha_specific_findings.statement: FormulaType numeric2, AbilityTargetEntity; percentage Skill02 parameter0 and flat parameter3. Core base is healer MaxHP.

natasha_specific_findings.name: PointB1/key6 and PointB3/key8
natasha_specific_findings.statement: Key6 gates Dispel, Numbers uses PointB1 parameter0. Key8 selects SkillTree_LifeTime write from PointB3 parameter0 or raw0. Static points1105101/1105103 require promotion2/6; actual dictionary comes from supplied SkillTreeDataList.

natasha_specific_findings.name: MAvatar_Natasha_00_HOT_HPByMaxHP
natasha_specific_findings.statement: Selected modifier starts10900419, body ends10900617. Numeric stack7, life-step moment1, event6, UseSnapshotEntity bit16=true. Lifetime = Skill02.parameter2 + SkillTree_LifeTime; MDFs bind parameter1/4 and remain future-turn healing state.

natasha_specific_findings.name: PassiveSkill01 / SkillP01
natasha_specific_findings.statement: Default point1105004 links Skill110504. Static level1 HP-ratio threshold raw2576980380 and boost2147483650; event44 compares ParamEntity HP ratio (CompareType5) and modifies HealData; event129 relates to snapshot data.

superseded_assumptions.old_project_assumption: Natasha Skill02 native-equivalent semantic closure must complete before generic Battle Runtime implementation begins.
superseded_assumptions.replacement: Recovered real-content/native semantics are sufficient to define evidence-graded generic runtime primitives and begin the independent deterministic Battle Runtime. Native runtime observation is used to validate/refine uncertain semantics, not to block the entire implementation.
superseded_assumptions.superseded_scope: Any interpretation of old Natasha-specific next-phase/R1 gates as a global generic-runtime prerequisite; existing fact/confidence/authorization boundaries remain unchanged

future_resume.only_when: Explicitly requested for validation, calibration or native-equivalence research
minimum_next_evidence: Effective provider identities and raw values
future_resume.possibly_later: One separately authorized selected ordinary action observation for atomic-end/RNG/controller-event drain, only if initialization evidence plus remaining native joins is insufficient
future_resume.after_evidence: Continue remaining selected native joins; acquisition alone does not close semantics
future_resume.live_permissions: Require a new explicit authorization for initialization; selected action observation separately authorized. This archive grants neither.
future_resume.resume_integrity: Verify path/SHA references or restore exact members from recorded prior ZIPs; do not treat deterministic replay or supplied capture schema validation as native authority
